title: Count Days Spent Together
summary: Alice and Bob are traveling to Rome for separate business meetings.
statement: Alice and Bob are traveling to Rome for separate business meetings. You are provided with their arrival and departure dates in the format "MM-DD". Calculate the total number of days both Alice and Bob are in Rome together. Note that all dates are within the same non-leap year, and the number of days in each month is as follows: [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31].
constraints: Dates use MM-DD within the same non-leap year.
Arrival and departure dates are both included.
Return the number of calendar days when both people are present.
hints: Convert each MM-DD date to a one-based day-of-year using month lengths.
The overlap begins at the later arrival and ends at the earlier departure.
If end < start return zero; otherwise return end-start+1 for inclusive dates.
Intersection endpoints characterize exactly the dates contained in both intervals.
editorial: Intersection endpoints characterize exactly the dates contained in both intervals.

tests.explanation: The inclusive overlap is August sixteenth through eighteenth, totaling three days.
The intervals do not overlap, so the result is zero.
